note: Each vector is one rule, stated so that any engine can be held to it. scope 'protocol' binds every implementation; scope 'reference' binds only the FRAME reference runtime in chain/, because it names that runtime's pallets or consensus. 'frame' is the line the reference end-to-end run prints for this vector; 'jambo' records whether the JAM services check it yet.

vectors.rule: The runtime carries the protocol and nothing else.
vectors.expect: Pallets are exactly System, Timestamp, Aura, Grandpa, Seeds.
vectors.frame: runtime is five pallets and nothing else

vectors.rule: A network starts from a named set of first members.
vectors.expect: Member count at genesis equals the first members in the genesis config (3 in the test genesis).
vectors.frame: genesis: three first members

vectors.rule: Joining mints nothing.
vectors.expect: Every first member's balance at genesis is 0.
vectors.frame: first members hold nothing: joining mints no units

vectors.rule: Units are a record, not a currency.
vectors.expect: There is no call that moves units between members.
vectors.frame: there is no transfer call: units are a record, not a currency

vectors.rule: Opening control exists at genesis and can be ended.
vectors.expect: Opening control is active at genesis.
vectors.frame: opening control is on

vectors.rule: Validators at genesis are the ones the genesis config names.
vectors.expect: Aura authorities at genesis = 2 in the test genesis.
vectors.frame: two validators at genesis

vectors.rule: Only members write.
vectors.expect: Any signed call from a non-member is refused before it reaches the pool.
vectors.frame: a non-member cannot write, refused before the pool

vectors.rule: One witness is not enough.
vectors.expect: After one member witnesses a candidate, the candidate is still not a member.
vectors.frame: one witness is not enough

vectors.rule: Witnesses must name the same evidence.
vectors.expect: A second witness naming different session evidence is refused (CandidacyMismatch).
vectors.frame: witnesses must agree on the evidence

vectors.rule: Two witnesses on the same evidence admit, and admission mints nothing.
vectors.expect: Admitted is emitted; Minted is not.
vectors.frame: second witness admits Dave, and nothing is minted
vectors.jambo: partial: the member register writes a member; witness signatures are next

vectors.rule: A new member arrives with a vote and an empty balance.
vectors.expect: The new member's balance is 0.
vectors.frame: Dave arrives with a vote and an empty balance

vectors.rule: Members write without fees.
vectors.expect: A signed call from the new member succeeds with no balance.
vectors.frame: Dave can now write, feelessly

vectors.rule: A claim is bound to one network.
vectors.expect: A claim signed over another network's genesis hash is refused.
vectors.frame: a claim signed for another network is refused

vectors.rule: A claim is bound to one destination.
vectors.expect: A claim signed for a different destination is refused.
vectors.frame: a claim signed for someone else is refused

vectors.rule: The old key alone moves a snapshot balance to its new holder.
vectors.expect: A valid claim signed 'seeds-claim:' ++ genesis_hash ++ dest credits dest with the snapshot amount, with no signature from dest.
vectors.frame: Ferdie's old key moves the snapshot to Dave, unsigned by Dave

vectors.rule: A snapshot entry is claimed once.
vectors.expect: Unclaimed total falls to 0 after the only entry is claimed.
vectors.frame: nothing left unclaimed

vectors.rule: Any member may queue for a seat by registering keys.
vectors.expect: Key holders grow by one.
vectors.frame: Dave queues for a seat

vectors.rule: A point needs no bond, and fewer than three challenges leave it pending.
vectors.expect: After one challenge the point is still Pending with a maturity block set.
vectors.frame: a point with no bond, matures at

vectors.rule: Three challenges fail a point: nothing is minted and the proposer takes a strike.
vectors.expect: Failed is emitted; proposer strikes = 1.
vectors.frame: three challenges fail a point: nothing minted, a strike on the proposer

vectors.rule: A first member's upgrade passes unless members object.
vectors.expect: With no objection, closing the motion authorises the code hash.
vectors.frame: a first member's upgrade with no objection is authorised

vectors.rule: Authorised code is applied by any member, without a superuser.
vectors.expect: spec_version rises by one; no sudo exists.
vectors.frame: any member applies the authorised code: forkless upgrade, no sudo

vectors.rule: Members end opening control by simple majority, once.
vectors.expect: With 3 of 4 in favour, OpeningEnded is emitted and opening control is off.
vectors.frame: members vote opening control away, 3 of 4

vectors.rule: An unchallenged point matures at its block.
vectors.expect: Status is Matured after the maturity block.
vectors.frame: the point matured

vectors.rule: Maturity is the only place units are created.
vectors.expect: The proposer's balance rises by exactly the maturity amount (10 units in the test genesis).
vectors.frame: the maturity mint, the only one

vectors.rule: Issuance is the sum of maturities plus the claimed snapshot.
vectors.expect: Total issuance = 10 + 1000 units in the test run.
vectors.frame: issuance = one maturity + the snapshot, nothing else

vectors.rule: At an era boundary, queued members' keys join block production.
vectors.expect: Aura authorities = 3.
vectors.frame: at the era, Dave's keys join Aura

vectors.rule: The protocol records who holds a seat.
vectors.expect: Seeds validators = 3.
vectors.frame: Seeds records three seats

vectors.rule: Finality continues across a set change.
vectors.expect: GRANDPA finalises more than five blocks past the era boundary.
vectors.frame: GRANDPA finalises past the set change with three voters
